findings.area: Village Guardian mapper-to-denominator lineage and V11 gate correctness
findings.detail: Village reconciliation V5 correctly replaces 15 malformed graph IDs, but the active Village mapper report is still V4 and binds reconciliation V4. The active mapper receipt V5 likewise binds report V4 and reconciliation V4, not the corrected V5 bytes. V11 hides this stale lineage by setting MAPPER_DENOMINATOR_RELATIVE for Village to V4 while selecting V5 only for the collector reconciliation, then reports the denominator-mapper gate green. This does not satisfy review-v5's required additive mapper supersession over every exact accepted denominator record and violates the exactly-once exact-denominator gate; one denominator mismatch stops the batch.
findings.required_remediation: Publish an additive Village mapper report and receipt that bind the exact reconciliation V5 SHA-256, select that report/receipt as active, remove the V4 special-case from the truth contract, rerun the full exact gates, and obtain another fresh independent review.

findings.detail: AR-B2-ASSET-001..003 still encode binary whole-file evidence with line-shaped start_line/end_line objects. V11's binary-aware parser treats equal blob/range hashes as whole-file and resolves them correctly, but a schema-generic line-range consumer can misread these records.
findings.required_remediation: In a future additive Archer ledger, encode the three binary records explicitly as whole-file or byte ranges without changing their verified whole-file hashes.
